author: Arachadonic
body:
For a server as reasonably big as this to be down, both forums and ingame server, for roughly 7 hours the other day is a big deal, but I feel like its not being treated as one. 
There are and has been countless threads in relation to this "timing out" issue many people, including myself, experience and I can tell you right now that it ruins games. I am lucky some days to finish a match without timing out and having to rejoin the server. This is not good guys. Not at all.

So IvyCode, I know you probably won't see this as you rarely grace us with your presence and I don't mean you any disrespect but get your shit together. When players complain about stuff like this it is wise to start listening to them or else soon you might find yourself with no players.
In my opinion, I think you should stop developing whatever it is that keeps you so busy and focus on making the experience on Avicus as enjoyable as possible which currently due to the technical problems, it is not really that enjoyable anymore which saddens me.

Thanks and I hope this actually gets looked at.
